hero.name: Modular Container Cabins
hero.tagline: Custom-built container spaces delivered in 7–15 days. Site offices, dormitories, cafes, security cabins — any configuration.

overview: Crystal Group's dry fabricated units are custom-built from repurposed shipping containers — portable, durable spaces with insulation, ventilation, electrical fittings, and optional plumbing. Save up to 40% versus conventional construction. Available as site offices, dormitories, container cafes, security cabins, medical rooms, and more. Move via forklift or crane — no permanent foundation required.

faq.q: What sizes are available for container cabins?
faq.a: We offer 20 ft and 40 ft cabins, with the option for fully customised sizes depending on project needs.

faq.q: Are container cabins weatherproof and durable?
faq.a: Yes. Our cabins are built using strong, rust-resistant steel and insulated panels for long-term performance in all weather conditions.

faq.q: How long does it take to install a container cabin?
faq.a: Most units are ready within 7–15 days, depending on design complexity and customisation.

faq.q: What foundation is required for installation?
faq.a: A level concrete or RCC surface is sufficient for installation. Our team provides full site setup guidance.
